faq.subtitle: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
faq.description: Everything you need to know about our recruitment partnerships, service guarantees, and hiring timelines.

items.question: How quickly can NexHire deliver a candidate shortlist?
items.answer: For urgent roles and standard engineering positions, our proprietary pipeline enables us to present the first qualified shortlist within 48 to 72 hours. Executive search engagements typically deliver a benchmarked longlist within 7 to 10 days.

items.question: What is NexHire's placement guarantee policy?
items.answer: All our direct-hire and executive placements come with a comprehensive replacement warranty ranging from 90 to 180 days. In the rare event a placement does not work out, we find an equal replacement at zero additional cost.

items.question: Do you support international remote hiring and global payroll?
items.answer: Yes. Through our Global Remote & Employer of Record (EOR) partnerships, we help you legally hire, onboard, and pay talent across 35+ countries while maintaining 100% local labor and tax compliance.

items.question: What industries and verticals does NexHire specialize in?
items.answer: We maintain dedicated practice groups in Information Technology & Software Engineering, C-Suite & Executive Leadership, FinTech & Banking, Healthcare & Life Sciences, and Supply Chain & Operations.

items.question: What are your fee structures for recruitment?
items.answer: We offer flexible models tailored to client needs: Retained Search for senior executive roles, Contingency Recruitment for specialized mid-to-senior hires, and scalable RPO (Recruitment Process Outsourcing) month-to-month contracts.
